annotation.title_en: Nissan Qashqai and the Collapsed Wall
annotation.summary_en: A customer at a car dealership inquires about the expensive Nissan Qashqai, only to reveal a bizarre reason for needing that specific model.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place in a bright Nissan car dealership showroom. A customer wearing a tan jacket approaches an enthusiastic, mustached car salesman to inquire about a silver Nissan Qashqai SUV. The customer asks a series of technical questions in colloquial Armenian, verifying if the car has a leather interior, 'zadni' (reverse gear/camera), parking sensors, and 'climax control' (a malapropism for climate control). The salesman politely corrects him, noting features like power mirrors and a 'tiptronic' gearbox. When the price is revealed to be over ten million drams, the customer repeatedly complains that it is too expensive, even when offered a three-year installment plan. The salesman eventually suggests that the man should look for a more affordable car, like a Nissan Tiida. The customer agrees it would be more logical, but delivers the punchline: he only wants this specific Qashqai because his stone wall collapsed, and the gap in the wall is exactly the size and shape of this particular vehicle.
catchphrases: ավելի ճիշտ չէր լինի որ դուք ձեր համար ավելի մատչելի մեքենա ընտրեիք
պռոստը շարածս պատը փլվելա տոշնի սենց մաշնի վրա
